moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.description: Hide or feature pages of each web and publish announcements in its header, in one language or in all of them. It applies without publishing a snapshot.
moderation.delay: The webs apply it in less than 30 s, without publishing or restarting.
moderation.filterHint: Each language sees its own rules and announcements and those of every language.

rule.reasonTooLong: The reason has more than {max} characters.
rule.hideText: {where} will answer 404 on {site} and leave the navigation. Removing the rule brings it back.
rule.hideTextSite: {where} will answer 404 on {site} and leave the navigation, the search, the sitemap and llms.txt. Removing the rule brings it back.
rule.removeHidden: {path} exists again on {site}: its page, the navigation and the search.
rule.removeFeatured: {path} is no longer shown as featured.
rule.reasonPlaceholder: Optional: why, for the rest of the team
rule.existing: This page already has a rule in that language ({action}, by {author}): saving replaces it.
rule.empty: No rules: the web shows all its pages and features none.
rule.caption: Rules of {site}

moderation.announcementsHint: In the header of {site}; each reader can close them.

announcement.placeholder: Write the message to see the announcement.
announcement.tooLong: The message has more than {max} characters.
announcement.badDate: One of the dates is not valid.
announcement.deleteText: It disappears from the web and from the history. To stop showing it without losing it, deactivate it.
announcement.datesHint: Optional, in your local time. Without a start it shows now; without an end, until you deactivate it.
announcement.caption: Announcements of {site}, newest first

preview.title: Preview
preview.inactive: Inactive: it will not show until you activate it.
preview.ended: Its end has passed: it will not show.
preview.now: It shows now, with no end date.
